title: Build Tabs with Dynamic Components
short_description: Practice dynamic components and KeepAlive by building a tabbed settings view.
description: Complete App.vue to switch between ProfileTab and SecurityTab through component :is.
Then complete SecurityTab.vue to control the visibility of the recovery codes.
instructions: In App.vue, wrap the dynamic component with KeepAlive.
In SecurityTab.vue, use v-show to hide or display the recovery codes panel.
Do not replace the tabs with independent v-if branches or the panel with v-if.

hints.title: Active component
hints.body: `tabs[currentTab]` contains the component definition to render.

hints.title: Preserve state
hints.body: `KeepAlive` must directly wrap the dynamic component.

hints.title: Panel visibility
hints.body: Apply `v-show` to the element with `data-testid="recovery-codes"` using `showRecoveryCodes`
